description: This file is a C source file for the Zephyr RTOS, configuring hardware specifics for the MIMXRT595 EVK board, including power management, clock setup, and regulator configuration.

methods.name: board_calc_volt_level
methods.description: Calculates voltage level based on system core clock and predefined frequency thresholds.

methods.name: board_config_pmic
methods.description: Configures the power management IC regulators and sets initial power states.

methods.name: board_pmic_change_mode
methods.description: Changes the PMIC mode to a specified power mode.

methods.name: power_manager_set_profile
methods.description: Sets power profile including clock and voltage configurations based on the specified profile.

methods.name: mimxrt595_evk_init
methods.description: Initializes the board, including voltage ranges, clock setup, OTP fuse reading, and power management configuration.

methods.name: init_psram_framebufs
methods.description: Zeroes out PSRAM framebuffers section in memory.
